questions.question: Which contributions in the 2009 Joint Committee on Health and Children record are substantively about health policy?
questions.review_criteria: Relevant when the contribution substantively discusses health-sector policy, service organization, planning, regulation or public provision; incidental use of the word health is not enough.

questions.question: Which Seanad contributions on 27 February 2025 concern fisheries policy?
questions.review_criteria: Relevant when the contribution substantively concerns fisheries policy, management or regulation; a passing reference to fishing or the marine sector is not sufficient.

questions.question: Find Seanad contributions in 2025 about fishing industry topics, explicitly including narrower EuroVoc concepts.
questions.review_criteria: Relevant when fishing, fisheries or fishing-industry activity is a material subject, including a specific narrower activity. A passing reference to coastal or marine matters is insufficient.

questions.question: Which Dáil contributions from 25 February 2026 discuss climate change?
questions.review_criteria: Relevant when climate change or its impacts are a substantive topic; weather, energy or environmental mentions without a climate link are not sufficient.

questions.question: Compare contributions relating to public health in the 2009 health committee record and the 2026 Public Accounts record, explicitly including narrower EuroVoc topics.
questions.review_criteria: Relevant when population health, prevention, public-health systems or a directly narrower public-health topic is materially discussed; private/individual medical care alone is not enough.

questions.question: Which Dáil contributions from 25 February 2026 are about education policy, rather than merely mentioning a school or education?
questions.review_criteria: Relevant only when education-system policy, governance, access, funding or organization is a substantive topic. Mentions of schools or education as incidental context are irrelevant; mark genuine ambiguity uncertain.

questions.question: Which contributions are present in the sampled Seanad debate from 27 February 2025?
questions.review_criteria: Control query answered from the transformed debate structure and validated HouseTerm owner graph; no subject classifier is used. Results are limited to the selected sample, not all source speeches.
